## Introduction

This is the starting Quarto document for the Census tutorial.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```
## Texas income

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- tryCatch(
  {
    get_acs(
      geography = "county",
      variables = "B19013_001",
      state = "TX",
      year = 2020,
      geometry = TRUE
    )
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("ACS request failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(income_tx)) {
  income_tx
} else {
  message("income_tx is unavailable because the ACS request failed.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(income_tx)) {
  glimpse(income_tx)
} else {
  message("income_tx is unavailable because the ACS request failed.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(income_tx)) {
  income_tx |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    summarize(
      min_income = min(estimate),
      median_income = median(estimate),
      max_income = max(estimate),
      median_moe = median(moe)
    )
} else {
  message("income_tx is unavailable because the ACS request failed.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(income_tx)) {
  ggplot(income_tx, aes(x = estimate)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#2b8cbe", color = "white") +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of median household income across Texas counties",
      x = "Median household income",
      y = "Number of counties"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
} else {
  message("income_tx is unavailable because the ACS request failed.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(income_tx)) {
  ggplot(income_tx) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate))
} else {
  message("income_tx is unavailable because the ACS request failed.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(income_tx)) {
  ggplot(income_tx) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Median income") +
    labs(
      title = "Median household income by county, Texas (2020)",
      caption = "Source: ACS 5-year estimates via tidycensus"
    ) +
    theme_void()
} else {
  message("income_tx is unavailable because the ACS request failed.")
}
```
